def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    times = np.linspace(0, duration_s, 60)
    dt = np.diff(times, prepend=0)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, 60, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    points[:, 0, :2] = start
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0
    ok = np.ones(n_runs, dtype=bool)

    # Bearings sampled around west (180° = pi rad), with small noise for exploration
    # Use uniform noise ±30° (±pi/6)
    bearings_base = np.pi  # West
    bearing_noise = (rng.random(n_runs) - 0.5) * np.pi / 3  # ±30°
    bearings = bearings_base + bearing_noise

    # Precompute meters per degree
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon
    cell_m = terrain.cell_m

    lat = points[:, 0, 0]
    lon = points[:, 0, 1]
    sec = points[:, 0, 2]

    for i in range(1, 60):
        if not ok.any():
            points[~ok, i:] = np.nan
            break

        # Candidates: move cell_m (30m) in direction bearings
        lat_cand, lon_cand = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearings, cell_m)

        # Clamp inside terrain box (just for safe evaluation)
        lat_cand_cl, lon_cand_cl = terrain.clamp(lat_cand, lon_cand)

        # Compute slope at current and candidate points
        slope_curr = terrain.slope_deg(lat, lon)
        slope_cand = terrain.slope_deg(lat_cand_cl, lon_cand_cl)

        # Calculate fraction of slope >30° over 9 points in a 3x3 grid around candidate
        # Points 10m spacing in lat/lon directions (~0.03° cell ~30m)
        off = np.array([-1, 0, 1]) * cell_m  # offsets in meters
        off_lat = off[:, None] / m_lat  # shape(3,1)
        off_lon = off[None, :] / m_lon  # shape(1,3)

        # Generate grid lat/lon around candidates
        lat_grid = lat_cand_cl[:, None, None] + off_lat[None, :, None]
        lon_grid = lon_cand_cl[:, None, None] + off_lon[None, None, :]
        lat_grid = lat_grid.reshape((n_runs, 9))
        lon_grid = lon_grid.reshape((n_runs, 9))

        # Clamp grid points inside box
        lat_grid, lon_grid = terrain.clamp(lat_grid, lon_grid)
        slope_grid = terrain.slope_deg(lat_grid, lon_grid)
        frac_over_30 = np.mean(slope_grid > 30, axis=1)

        # We want moves that reduce or keep similar fraction over 30° slopes westward.
        # Calculate differences from current fraction over 30 at current locations:
        lat_curr_grid = lat[:, None] + off_lat[None, :, None]
        lon_curr_grid = lon[:, None] + off_lon[None, None, :]
        lat_curr_grid, lon_curr_grid = terrain.clamp(lat_curr_grid.reshape(n_runs,9), lon_curr_grid.reshape(n_runs,9))
        slope_curr_grid = terrain.slope_deg(lat_curr_grid, lon_curr_grid)
        frac_over_30_curr = np.mean(slope_curr_grid > 30, axis=1)

        # Condition: frac_over_30 candidate ≤ frac_over_30 current (allow small tolerance 0.01)
        cond = frac_over_30 <= frac_over_30_curr + 0.01

        # Also exclude movements outside terrain box (inside returns bool)
        inside = terrain.inside(lat_cand, lon_cand)

        move_ok = cond & inside & ok

        # Where can move, update. Else hold position.
        lat = np.where(move_ok, lat_cand, lat)
        lon = np.where(move_ok, lon_cand, lon)
        ok = ok & inside

        dist = np.full(n_runs, cell_m)
        elev_diff = terrain.elev(lat, lon) - terrain.elev(points[:, i-1, 0], points[:, i-1, 1])
        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(elev_diff, dist)
        speed = np.maximum(speed, 0.1)  # prevent zero or negative speed

        # Update time elapsed, preserving monotonicity:
        step_time = dist / speed
        step_time = np.minimum(step_time, dt[i])  # do not exceed max interval

        # Accumulate time elapsed but ensure nondecreasing
        sec_new = sec + step_time
        sec = np.maximum(sec_new, sec)

        points[:, i, 0] = lat
        points[:, i, 1] = lon
        points[:, i, 2] = sec

    return points, ok
